name: Zapovednik novogo angela
source:
After years of wandering Shenetz returns to his once abandoned homeland.
Everything he remembered had been dismantled by time. His sons had forgotten their father and cursed him when they met.
On the ruins of his hometown he meets a girl who overcame the Death itself.
The stranger's tale about the price of this victory prompts Shenetz to tell his own story.
